setting.title: The Fenwick Vale Tastevin
setting.premise: Leonie Fenwick has gathered family and old friends at Fenwick Vale, her small family vineyard, to bring in the autumn harvest, with the first pressing on Monday. On Friday night the silver tastevin her late husband Malcolm wore at every harvest vanished from its hook above the tasting table in the cellar.
setting.missingItem: a silver tastevin, a shallow wine-tasting cup, on a faded green ribbon

timeline.text: Oskar loads every picking bucket into his truck to hose out at his own farm.
Jonah toasts his father, Malcolm's signet ring clinking on his glass. Leonie hangs the tastevin back on its hook and announces that Fenwick Vale will go to Nell.
Nell slips out to the top rows for a video call with a winery in Marlborough, where it is daytime.

Jonah takes the key from the kitchen hook and goes down the cellar stair, leaving his phone charging upstairs. He punches down the fermenting cap by hand as his father taught him, then lifts the tastevin off its hook, steadying a purple hand on the whitewash. He leaves the key in the stair door.
Oskar, up for the bathroom, sees Nell walking the top rows with her phone lit.
Ines finds the key in the stair door and creeps down for a taste of Malcolm's 2019 reserve. The hook is already empty. She hangs the key back on its hook on her way up.
Nell comes in through the kitchen and finds Jonah at the sink, scrubbing must off his hands.
Oskar tips three bins of his own Pinot into Leonie's harvest on the crush pad.
Nell goes out for a second-round call with Marlborough and is back by quarter to one.
Jonah slips down to the cellar, again without his phone, and scrubs his handprint off the wall.
Oskar is out on the crush pad early, as always.
Nell takes a last call from Marlborough and turns the job down. She's staying.
Out in the dark yard, Jonah lights his way with his phone. He cuts the green ribbon off the tastevin and tucks it into the glovebox of Ines's unlocked hire car by the crush pad.
Oskar readies Malcolm's old basket press. The tastevin is wrapped in a sock in Jonah's walking boot: the one thing of his father's he couldn't bear to see go to someone else.
